name: cdm/product/asset/floatingrate/FloatingRateProcessingParameters
description: Type to hold the processing parameters that should be or were used to calculate a floating amount.  These parameters can vary over a schedule so this type holds the acutal values applicable to this calculation.

capRate.description: capt to be applied to the floating rate.

floorRate.description: floor to be applied to the floating rate.

initialRate.description: The rate to be applied for the initial period.

negativeTreatment.description: How to handle negative interest rates.

rounding.description: THe final rate rounding to be applied.

spread.description: spread to be added to the floating rate.

treatment.description: US rate treatment (Bond Equivalent Yield or Money Market Yield, if applicable.
